description: The line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens, comparing two models: “MATTER (ours)” (pink line with circular markers and solid line style) and “w/o material information” (purple line with circular markers and solid line style). The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans from approximately 0.55 to 1.45 with major tick marks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58 with major ticks every 2 units. The pink line for MATTER begins at approximately 55.1% at x=0.6, rises to a peak of 58.0% at x=1.0, then declines to 50.8% at x=1.4. The purple line for w/o material information starts at 52.5% at x=0.6, peaks at 54.2% near x=0.7, then gradually decreases to 47.8% at x=1.4. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions representing variance; these overlap significantly around x=1.2, where the pink line is at ~52.8% and the purple line is at ~52.3%. The pink line consistently remains above the purple line across the entire x-axis range, indicating superior performance for MATTER, though both exhibit a performance drop at higher token counts, particularly beyond x=1.0 for MATTER and beyond x=1.2 for the baseline.
caption_used: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge during tokenization training across different numbers of tokens. The pink line representing MATTER (ours) starts at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score, peaks at 58% near x=1.0, and ends at 50% near x=1.3, showing a consistent decline after its peak. The purple line, representing w/o material information, begins at 52.5%, peaks at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range. The shaded areas indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2. The results suggest that MATTER consistently outperforms the alternative across all token counts, with a sharper decline in performance at higher token counts for both conditions.
